# NMC Hospital Fujairah

> This staff accommodation building in Fujairah houses medical and support personnel working at a private hospital in the city. Purpose-built residential blocks of this kind are common across the United Arab Emirates healthcare sector, providing single and shared rooms together with communal dining, laundry and recreation space. Siting the building close to the hospital keeps staff within a short commute of shift work.

## Project Overview

- Category: Advanced Technical Facilities
- Location: Fujairah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This staff accommodation building was developed for NMC Hospital in Fujairah to house the hospital's personnel close to their workplace. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the building for NMC Hospital, with Horizon International as consultant. The project complemented MENASCO's MEP works on NMC Hospital Fujairah itself, extending its support to the healthcare provider's east coast operations.
